```sql
WITH cohorts AS (
    -- Define cohorts based on customer signup month
    SELECT
        id AS customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS cohort_month
    FROM customers
),
customer_orders AS (
    -- Get the distinct months each customer placed an order
    SELECT DISTINCT
        o.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS order_month
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
),
cohort_orders AS (
    -- Join cohorts with their order activity
    SELECT
        c.cohort_month,
        c.customer_id,
        co.order_month,
        -- Calculate how many months after signup the order was placed (0 = same month)
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(co.order_month, c.cohort_month)) * 12
        + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(co.order_month, c.cohort_month)) AS months_since_signup
    FROM cohorts c
    LEFT JOIN customer_orders co
        ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
        AND co.order_month >= c.cohort_month
),
cohort_sizes AS (
    -- Count total customers per cohort
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS cohort_size
    FROM cohorts
    GROUP BY cohort_month
),
retention_data AS (
    -- Count active customers per cohort per month offset
    SELECT
        co.cohort_month,
        co.months_since_signup,
        COUNT(DISTINCT co.customer_id) AS active_customers
    FROM cohort_orders co
    WHERE co.months_since_signup IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY co.cohort_month, co.months_since_signup
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(rd.cohort_month, 'YYYY-MM')                                      AS cohort_month,
    cs.cohort_size,
    rd.months_since_signup::INT                                               AS month_number,
    active_customers,
    ROUND(
        (active_customers::DECIMAL / cs.cohort_size) * 100, 2
    )                                                                         AS retention_pct,
    -- Visual bar representation of retention
    REPEAT('█', ROUND((active_customers::DECIMAL / cs.cohort_size) * 20)::INT) AS retention_bar
FROM retention_data rd
JOIN cohort_sizes cs
    ON rd.cohort_month = cs.cohort_month
ORDER BY
    rd.cohort_month,
    rd.months_since_signup;
```

```sql
WITH customer_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::DATE AS cohort_month,
        DATE_PART('year', created_at)::INT AS cohort_year,
        DATE_PART('month', created_at)::INT AS cohort_month_num
    FROM customers
),
customer_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id,
        c.cohort_month,
        c.cohort_year,
        c.cohort_month_num,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS order_month,
        DATE_PART('year', o.order_date)::INT AS order_year,
        DATE_PART('month', o.order_date)::INT AS order_month_num
    FROM customer_cohorts c
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
),
cohort_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort_month,
        cohort_year,
        (order_year - cohort_year) * 12 + (order_month_num - cohort_month_num) AS months_since_signup
    FROM customer_orders
    WHERE order_month IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cohort_month, cohort_year, order_year, order_month_num, cohort_month_num
),
cohort_sizes AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort_month,
        cohort_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS cohort_size
    FROM customer_cohorts
    GROUP BY cohort_month, cohort_year
),
retention_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.cohort_month,
        cs.cohort_year,
        cs.cohort_size,
        cd.months_since_signup,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cd.id) AS customers_with_order
    FROM cohort_sizes cs
    LEFT JOIN cohort_data cd ON cs.cohort_month = cd.cohort_month 
        AND cs.cohort_year = cd.cohort_year
    GROUP BY cs.cohort_month, cs.cohort_year, cs.cohort_size, cd.months_since_signup
)
SELECT 
    cohort_month,
    cohort_size,
    months_since_signup,
    customers_with_order,
    ROUND(100.0 * customers_with_order / cohort_size, 2) AS retention_percentage
FROM retention_data
WHERE months_since_signup IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cohort_month, months_since_signup;
```

```sql
WITH customer_signups AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS signup_month
    FROM customers
),
order_months AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS order_month
    FROM orders
),
cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        cs.signup_month,
        om.order_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.id) AS cohort_size,
        COUNT(DISTINCT om.customer_id) AS ordered_customers
    FROM customer_signups cs
    LEFT JOIN order_months om ON cs.id = om.customer_id
    GROUP BY cs.signup_month, om.order_month
)
SELECT
    signup_month,
    order_month,
    cohort_size,
    ordered_customers,
    (ordered_customers::DECIMAL / cohort_size) * 100 AS retention_percentage
FROM cohorts
ORDER BY signup_month, order_month;
```

```sql
WITH cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        id AS customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS cohort_month
    FROM customers
),
order_months AS (
    SELECT
        c.cohort_month,
        o.customer_id,
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.cohort_month)) * 12 +
        (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.cohort_month)) AS month_diff
    FROM orders o
    JOIN cohorts c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
cohort_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        month_diff,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_customers
    FROM order_months
    GROUP BY cohort_month, month_diff
),
total_cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers
    FROM cohorts
    GROUP BY cohort_month
),
cohort_periods AS (
    SELECT
        c.cohort_month,
        generate_series(0, 
            (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.cohort_month)) * 12 +
            (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.cohort_month))
        ) AS month_diff
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT cohort_month FROM cohorts) c
)
SELECT
    cp.cohort_month,
    cp.month_diff,
    ROUND(COALESCE(cc.active_customers::numeric, 0) / tc.total_customers * 100, 2) AS retention_percentage
FROM cohort_periods cp
JOIN total_cohorts tc ON cp.cohort_month = tc.cohort_month
LEFT JOIN cohort_counts cc ON cp.cohort_month = cc.cohort_month AND cp.month_diff = cc.month_diff
ORDER BY cp.cohort_month, cp.month_diff;
```

```sql
WITH cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        id AS customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::DATE AS cohort_month
    FROM customers
),
cohort_sizes AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        COUNT(*) AS cohort_size
    FROM cohorts
    GROUP BY cohort_month
),
customer_activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.cohort_month,
        c.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS activity_month
    FROM cohorts c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
cohort_retention AS (
    SELECT
        ca.cohort_month,
        ca.activity_month,
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(ca.activity_month, ca.cohort_month)) * 12
            + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(ca.activity_month, ca.cohort_month)))::INT AS months_since_signup,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ca.customer_id) AS active_customers
    FROM customer_activity ca
    WHERE ca.activity_month >= ca.cohort_month
    GROUP BY ca.cohort_month, ca.activity_month
)
SELECT
    cr.cohort_month,
    cs.cohort_size,
    cr.activity_month,
    cr.months_since_signup,
    cr.active_customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * cr.active_customers / cs.cohort_size, 2) AS retention_percentage
FROM cohort_retention cr
JOIN cohort_sizes cs ON cs.cohort_month = cr.cohort_month
ORDER BY cr.cohort_month, cr.months_since_signup;
```
